description: This file defines a Java interface for interacting with the Nextcloud Notes API v0.2, including methods for retrieving, creating, editing, and deleting notes.

classes.name: NotesAPI_0_2
classes.description: Interface for the Nextcloud Notes API v0.2, providing methods to perform CRUD operations on notes.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes modified after a specified timestamp, with optional ETag for caching.

methods.name: getNotesIDs
methods.description: Retrieves IDs and metadata of notes, excluding content and other detailed fields.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note on the server.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its remote ID.

methods.name: editNote
methods.description: Edits an existing note identified by its remote ID.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note identified by its remote ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates a note by its ID with new data.
